title: More Barrels From Babylon
summary:
Iraqi Production and Exports Near Historic Highs
In the context of oil production growth, the US is the country that is often mentioned as the fastest growing non-OPEC producer. Within the group of OPEC countries, Iraq is the star performer with rapidly growing production. The International Energy Agency (IEA) estimates that in 2014, Iraq's oil production averaged 3.33 Million Barrel per day, the highest production since 1979, and a 7.5% increase over 2013.
